feynman_certification.listener_verdict: Finally, a tech video that doesn't treat me like a toddler. The hook was aggressive and hit a real pain point—everyone knows KV cache bloat is killing multi-agent performance right now. The librarian analogy in Beat 2 was actually useful because it framed the problem without being cringe or 'safe-drawer' level patronizing. I understood exactly how the mask works in Beat 4 without needing a PhD in architecture.
